name: DealNexis CRM
tagline: Next-Generation Automated Real Estate Deal Intelligence & Lead Matching Engine
description: Multi-tenant CRM with automated lead management and client tracking system.
overview: DealNexis is a comprehensive real estate CRM built to streamline lead management, property matching, and agent commission tracking. It includes an auto-deal matching engine, smart deal creation with scoring, and integrated Google Sheets sync.
features: REST API for third-party lead capture
highlights: Engineered automated lead-property compatibility scoring algorithm
Built resilient 2-way data bridge connecting MongoDB Atlas with Google Sheets
Implemented role-based agent workspace with transparent commission accounting

name: PropIntel
tagline: Centralized Workspace for High-Frequency Property Analysis & Workflow Automation
description: Property and lead intelligence workspace designed for smarter real estate workflows.
overview: PropIntel is a property and lead intelligence workspace focused on organizing property information, lead requirements and real estate workflows into a clean, useful interface.
highlights: Streamlined multi-attribute search across thousands of property records
Created distraction-free dark interface optimized for intensive broker sessions
Engineered client-side caching for instant UI state transitions

name: NaturalNestOrganic
tagline: Pure Brand Storytelling Meets High-Conversion D2C E-commerce Experience

It harmoniously combines authentic brand presence, dynamic product presentation, a full honey product catalog, and an effortless customer-facing purchase flow.
features: Mini e-commerce shopping bag & checkout interface
highlights: Crafted bespoke visual narrative reflecting pure organic craftsmanship
Engineered lightweight client-side cart with instant feedback
Optimized assets and layout for sub-second mobile page loads

name: LuxuryNest
tagline: High-End Architectural Real Estate Showcase with Automated Lead Ingestion
description: Real estate website with dynamic listings and automated lead capture.
overview: LuxuryNest is a fully responsive property listing platform integrated with Google Apps Script. It automates lead storage in Google Sheets and sends email notifications, making it perfect for real estate agents.
features: Automatic lead capture to Google Sheets
Instant email notifications for incoming leads
highlights: Implemented zero-maintenance serverless lead capture backend
Designed immersive editorial layout for premium luxury properties
Maintained 100% uptime with zero server cost overhead

name: WebCraft

description: Portfolio and client management platform for web agency.

highlights: Constructed client onboarding funnels with automated qualification
Integrated modular project showcase cards with rich hover effects
Clean separation of presentation layer and API endpoints

name: IronParadise
tagline: Specialized Member Lifecycle, Attendance & Subscription System
description: Custom gym management system for member tracking.
overview: IronParadise is a specialized web application designed for gym owners to manage memberships, track attendance, and handle subscription renewals effortlessly.
highlights: Automated subscription expiration calculation and renewal flags
Delivered single-touch attendance check-in for high-volume desk operations
Built visual membership analytics for revenue forecasting

tagline: Turnkey Real Estate Lead Generation & Advisory Demonstration Platform

Demonstrated instantaneous lead ingestion with zero hosting backend cost
Strict mobile-responsive design tuned for mobile property buyers

name: Deal Desk
tagline: From Property QR Scan to Closed Deal — One Intelligent Workspace
description: A real estate deal workspace that transforms physical property discovery into qualified leads, smart matches, personalized outreach, site visits, and closed deals.
overview: Deal Desk is a conversion-focused real estate workspace that connects property inventory, Smart QR lead acquisition, Open House visitor capture, intelligent property matching, personalized WhatsApp outreach, site visits, post-viewing feedback, negotiations, and deal closure into one streamlined workflow.
highlights: Designed a physical-to-digital lead acquisition workflow using dynamic property Smart QRs
Built a 7-factor matching engine to identify high-intent property-lead combinations
Connected lead qualification, WhatsApp outreach, site visits, viewing feedback, negotiations, and deal closure into one workspace
